sub_graphs.title: Beacon Metrics: Consensus State Monitoring
sub_graphs.description: Models the runtime metrics that track consensus state transitions including finalization, justification, and chain head progression

nodes.label: Epoch Transition Occurs
nodes.description: The beacon chain has transitioned to a new epoch, triggering metric updates

nodes.label: Update Finalized Epoch Metric
nodes.description: Update beacon_finalized_epoch gauge with the current finalized epoch number

nodes.label: Update Justified Epoch Metrics
nodes.description: Update beacon_current_justified_epoch and beacon_previous_justified_epoch gauges

nodes.label: Update Validator Count Metrics
nodes.description: Update beacon_current_active_validators and per-status counts (pending/active/exited/withdrawable)

nodes.label: Fork Choice Runs
nodes.description: Fork choice algorithm has executed, potentially updating head slot

nodes.label: Update Head Slot Metric
nodes.description: Update beacon_head_slot gauge with latest slot of the beacon chain

nodes.label: Increment Reorg Counter
nodes.description: Increment beacon_reorgs_total counter when a chain reorganization is detected

nodes.label: Update Sync State Metric
nodes.description: Update beacon_sync_state gauge: 0=not syncing, 1=synced, 2=syncing

sub_graphs.title: Beacon Metrics: Network and P2P Monitoring
sub_graphs.description: Models runtime metrics tracking network health including peer counts, gossip validation, and mesh topology

nodes.label: Peer Added or Dropped
nodes.description: A libp2p peer has been added to or removed from the peer set

nodes.label: Update Peer Count Metric
nodes.description: Update libp2p_peers gauge with current total number of connected libp2p peers

nodes.label: Update Mesh Peers per Topic
nodes.description: Update gossipsub_mesh_peers_per_main_topic gauge per gossipsub topic at each slot

nodes.label: Gossip Validation Failed
nodes.description: A pubsub message failed validation checks

nodes.label: Increment Validation Failure Counter
nodes.description: Increment libp2p_pubsub_validation_failure_total gauge

nodes.label: Record Attestation Delay
nodes.description: Record attestation arrival delay in beacon_attestation_delay_count histogram

nodes.label: Record Block Delay
nodes.description: Record block arrival delay in beacon_block_delay_count histogram

sub_graphs.title: Beacon Metrics: PeerDAS Data Column Processing
sub_graphs.description: Models metrics for data column sidecar processing, KZG verification, and data availability reconstruction

nodes.label: Data Column Sidecar Received
nodes.description: A data column sidecar has been submitted for gossip verification processing

nodes.label: Process Data Column Sidecar
nodes.description: Run gossip verification on data column sidecar, tracking beacon_data_column_sidecar_processing_requests_total

nodes.label: Batch KZG Verification
nodes.description: Run batched KZG verification, tracked by beacon_kzg_verification_data_column_batch_seconds histogram

nodes.label: Verify Inclusion Proof
nodes.description: Verify data column sidecar inclusion proof, tracked by beacon_data_column_sidecar_inclusion_proof_verification_seconds

nodes.label: Data Column Verified
nodes.description: Data column passed all verification; increments beacon_data_column_sidecar_processing_successes_total

nodes.label: Reconstruct Missing Columns
nodes.description: Reconstruct unavailable columns from available ones, tracked by beacon_data_availability_reconstructed_columns_total and reconstruction_time_seconds

nodes.label: Update Custody Group Metrics
nodes.description: Update beacon_custody_groups and beacon_custody_groups_backfilled gauges

ambiguities.text: Many metrics are listed as 'Gauge' but described with counter-like behavior (e.g., 'Total number of attestations received') - the metric type semantics are inconsistent.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume metrics labeled as gauges but describing totals are actually counters that may be reset at epoch boundaries. Implementations should clarify monotonicity.

ambiguities.text: The collection events for some metrics are specified as 'Epoch transition' even for metrics that logically change per-slot (e.g., beacon_attestations_received_total).
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume the collection event indicates when the metric is reported to Prometheus, not when the underlying value changes. Values may accumulate continuously.

implicit_assumptions.description: The Prometheus metrics endpoint (default 0.0.0.0:8008) is assumed to be accessible only to authorized monitoring infrastructure.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Information disclosure: an attacker could enumerate validator counts, sync state, peer topology, and chain health to identify vulnerable or out-of-sync nodes.

implicit_assumptions.description: Metric collection overhead is assumed to be negligible relative to consensus processing time.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Performance degradation: excessive metric instrumentation could slow down critical-path operations like block processing and attestation validation.
